name: fastapi-tasks
shape: FastAPI with background and scheduled tasks

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: a self-hosted app: docker/docker-compose.yml runs it on one host and the publish workflow only pushes images to registries; nothing names a host

processes.what: FastAPI (uvicorn) serving the API and the generated Nuxt frontend
processes.note: ENTRYPOINT docker/entry.sh runs `mealie` (pyproject [project.scripts] mealie.main:main, uvicorn mealie.app:app on :9000); the frontend is built by `pnpm generate` in the frontend-builder stage and mounted as an SPA by mealie/routes/spa

data.note: DB_ENGINE: sqlite (also the default in mealie/core/settings/settings.py); the file lives in the mealie-data volume at /app/data; mealie/core/settings/db_providers.py builds the sqlite:/// URL
DB_ENGINE=postgres with POSTGRES_* variables; the compose file carries them but selects sqlite
volume mealie-data:/app/data (Dockerfile VOLUME $MEALIE_HOME/data/): recipe images and assets, user avatars, backups, the generated secret

breaks.note: @repeat_every loops (every 5 minutes, hourly, daily at DAILY_SCHEDULE_TIME_UTC) started from the FastAPI lifespan in mealie/app.py: webhooks, token and export purges, timeline events
bg_tasks.add_task(bulk_scraper.scrape, bulk) scrapes many URLs after the response
every event's notifications (Apprise, webhooks) are published through FastAPI BackgroundTasks after the response
a recipe action POSTs to an external URL in a background task
the test webhook is sent in a background task
scraped and uploaded recipe images are written into DATA_DIR/recipes
profile images copied into the user's folder under DATA_DIR (the first hit, line 34, is a temporary path; line 39 is the persistent copy)
backup and restore copy the SQLite file and data folders inside DATA_DIR

determine_secrets generates the secret on first start and saves it into DATA_DIR; without a shared disk each instance signs tokens with a different secret. The line names tmp_file, so the rule's unless drops it
SQLite through SQLAlchemy is the default and the compose choice; no sqlite3.connect line exists, so the rule's regex does not reach it
a new user gets a default profile image copied into their folder under DATA_DIR (shutil.copy); hidden in the baseline behind the five places a finding lists
the OpenID avatar is minified in a temporary path, then moved into the user folder under DATA_DIR (shutil.move, line 292); the first write, line 288, is the temporary one

breaks.why: a group export is built in a temporary path, then copied into the group's export folder under DATA_DIR, where it is served for download later; hidden by the five-places cap until the corpus test listed every place
a migration copies the old installation's image folders into each recipe's directory under DATA_DIR (shutil.copytree); hidden by the five-places cap
an uploaded recipe asset is written into the recipe's asset directory under DATA_DIR (dest.open('wb')); hidden by the five-places cap

notBreaks.why: EventSourceResponse streams the progress of one recipe creation and closes when it is done; a request-bounded stream, not a connection held open
asyncio.create_task(schedule_daily()) is the scheduler's own start at app startup, not work after a response (the timer itself is the in-process-timer break)
a code generator run by developers that writes TypeScript types into frontend/; dev/ is not in NOT_APP
a code generator run by developers
generates test route files for developers
template helper of the developer code generators
a developer tool that anonymizes backup files
renders an export into a temporary directory (self.temp) that is returned as a download
the debug image is written into get_temporary_path() and discarded
browser code of the Nuxt frontend, built to static files
the uploaded archive is copied into get_temporary_zip_path() for one migration and discarded; the unless of the rule does not see the with line above

notes: Read docker/Dockerfile, docker/entry.sh, docker/docker-compose.yml, pyproject.toml, mealie/main.py, mealie/app.py, the scheduler package and the hits of every Python rule outside tests/. One process: the scheduler runs inside the web process (lifespan), and alembic migrations run at startup in mealie/db/init_db.py rather than in a release step. Several shutil.copyfileobj hits write into temporary paths (recipe_service.py create_from_zip, ai_recipe_service.py, controller_migrations.py, users/images.py line 34) and are not breaks; the files listed in local-disk-write are the ones that persist data in DATA_DIR. mealie/scripts/ holds admin commands (change_password, make_admin) run by hand, and the SQLite default is listed as a break even though no regex line shows it.

known.FALSE idle: long-lived-connection mealie: EventSourceResponse is a server-sent stream by definition, and the rule cannot tell one that ends with the request (this one) from one held open; the finding is idle, not breaks, and stays
known.MISSED break: local-disk-write mealie/co: the secret is written to a file named tmp_file in the same function, which the rule's temporary-path check reads as a scratch file; the real destination is DATA_DIR
known.data missing: db postg: Postgres is the optional engine, chosen by DB_ENGINE in settings; no manifest names a driver
known.data missing: sqlite: the default engine is SQLite through SQLAlchemy, chosen in settings and a compose environment value; the file lives in a volume no reader maps
